32565-xiii.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation through a supplementary budget (Najaarsnota), changing appropriations and receipts across policy articles. It does not delegate rule-making power or shift powers between executive and checks.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation (XIII) for 2010 is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.

Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie (XIII) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32860-(R1962).s: The bill amends the Dutch Passport Act to remove the possibility of adding children to a parent's passport, implementing EU Regulation 444/2009. Existing child entries lapse from 26 June 2012 while the passports themselves remain valid for the holder.
32860-(R1962).j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary because of the EU regulation and the abolition of child entries, with only technical detail left to regulation.
q: All references to the possibility of adding children are removed from several articles.
Alle verwijzingen naar de mogelijkheid tot bijschrijving van kinderen worden uit diverse artikelen geschrapt.
d: rules on how facial image, fingerprints and signature are recorded in travel documents
designating documents without certain biometric data and exemptions from recording them
authorities competent to amend travel documents and related rules
p: The Minister may designate additional authorities competent to amend travel documents by regulation.

parties: Asks the government about the costs of separate passports for children and about EU rules for children travelling across external borders.
The consequence of the bill is that children need their own passport or identity card.
Het gevolg van het wetsvoorstel is dat kinderen een eigen paspoort dan wel een eigen identiteitskaart nodig hebben.
Worries that not physically cancelling old child entries will cause parental confusion and possible misuse, and asks whether cancellation is possible when parents apply for new passports.
Asks about cost increases for families, including reduced fares, free passports under an age limit, and low-income relief.
Regarding the financial consequences, these members have a number of questions.
Over de financiële gevolgen leeft bij deze leden een aantal vragen.
Raises problems for parents with a different surname from their child, who may face extra questioning at customs and additional costs to prove parentage.
Will the inconvenience for parents with a different surname increase if children can no longer be added to the parent's passport?
Zal de hinder voor ouders met een afwijkende achternaam in omvang toenemen als kinderen niet meer bijgeschreven kunnen worden in het paspoort van de ouder?
Asks how identity of very young children can be secured, what a reasonable validity period is, and how biometric collection problems fit the one-person-one-passport requirement.
These members ask the government what a reasonable validity period is for passports of (very) young children.
Deze leden vragen de regering wat een redelijke geldigheidstermijn is voor paspoorten van (zeer) jonge kinderen.

33000-B.s: This bill formally sets the 2012 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) at €18.3 billion, with commitment amounts for the general grant and integration and decentralisation grants. It also sets the budget in thousands of euros and fixes entry-into-force rules.
q: The budget statement of the municipal fund for the year 2012 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2012 wordt vastgesteld.

33228-(R1981).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 1995 Strasbourg Convention on maritime drug trafficking (implementing Article 17 of the UN Drugs Convention) and attaches a reservation on translation requirements for requests under Article 19(3). It sets out the powers of intervening states over suspected drug vessels and the transfer of persons and evidence to flag states.
33228-(R1981).j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need for swift and effective action against drug smuggling at sea and a uniform legal framework, with access to a judge preserved.
q: The Convention provides a uniform legal framework for acting against vessels suspected of drug smuggling.
Het Verdrag zorgt voor een uniform juridisch kader voor het optreden tegen vaartuigen ten aanzien waarvan vermoedens van drugssmokkel bestaan.
p: Intervening states may stop, board, search, detain persons and seize goods at sea under the treaty, with the memorandum noting such measures are bounded by Dutch criminal procedure safeguards.

parties: Asks whether the Convention's rules on informing the flag state of evidence of other crimes are codified in Dutch law and how.
Can the government explain why it is only now starting the ratification process for the Kingdom of the Netherlands?
Kan de regering duidelijk maken waarom zij het bekrachtigingsproces voor het Koninkrijk der Nederland eerst nu in gang zet?
Worried about conflicts between states over boarding, including whether proportionality and subsidiarity were respected by the non-flag state.
How large does the government estimate the chance of conflicts between states following intervention by the non-flag state?
Hoe groot schat de regering de kans op conflicten tussen staten naar aanleiding van ingrijpen van de niet-vlaggestaat?
Asks what constitutes a reasonable suspicion and whether there are exceptions to the flag state's prior authorisation requirement, and what legal basis exists for acting against stateless vessels.
What is the legal basis for criminal law action against stateless vessels?
Wat is de grondslag voor het strafrecht optreden tegen stateloze vaartuigen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the bill approving the 1995 Strasbourg Convention on maritime drug smuggling but asks the explanatory memorandum to address the implementing legislation planned for Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten and state when it is expected. The government replied that paragraph 6 on the Kingdom position has been supplemented with that information, and the advice was followed.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should elaborate on the implementing legislation for Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten and indicate when it is expected to be ready.

33605-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the budget statement for its operating-cost agencies, through a supplementary (Slotwet) adjustment of appropriations and realised figures. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers and no oversight changes, and the explanatory memorandum extract is empty.
q: We, Willem-Alexander, by the grace of God, King of the Netherlands, Prince of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Willem-Alexander, bij de gratie Gods, Koning der Nederlanden, Prins van Oranje- Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

33968-(R2033).s: The bill approves for the entire Kingdom of the Netherlands the Arms Trade Treaty, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution before the Kingdom can be bound by it. It sets the entry into force on the day after publication in the Staatsblad and orders publication in the Staatsblad and in the official gazettes of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten.
q: The Arms Trade Treaty requires approval by the States General under Article 91(1) of the Constitution before the Kingdom can be bound by it.
Het Wapenhandelsverdrag, ingevolge artikel 91, eerste lid, van de Grondwet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal behoeft, alvorens het Koninkrijk daaraan kan worden gebonden

parties: Asks how much the treaty changes export practice outside the EU and how it could prevent arms supplies to Assad's Syria, without raising oversight or rights concerns.
How does the government estimate the treaty could contribute to not supplying weapons to, for example, the Assad regime in Syria?
Hoe schat de regering in dat het verdrag bijvoorbeeld kan bijdragen aan het niet leveren van wapens aan bijvoorbeeld het regime van Assad in Syrië?
Asks what sanctions or measures apply when states violate the prohibitions in Article 6, and why the treaty contains no sanctions against signatories that breach it.
Why was no provision finally included with sanctions against countries that have signed the treaty and do not comply with it?
Waarom is er uiteindelijk geen bepaling opgenomen met sancties tegen landen die het verdrag hebben ondertekend en zich niet aan het verdrag houden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised approval of the Arms Trade Treaty for the whole Kingdom but noted that it would initially apply only to European and Caribbean Netherlands, not Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, pending their implementing legislation, and asked the government to state when that legislation would be ready and the consequences of delay. The government's nader rapport reports that the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on the Kingdom position, as advised.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum state when the implementing legislation for Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten is expected, or set out the consequences of its absence, and the government added this to the Kingdom-position section.

The Afdeling stressed the Kingdom's and the international legal order's interest in timely approval and ratification for the whole Kingdom, which the government addressed in the supplemented memorandum.

34000-A.s: This bill sets the 2015 budget of the Infrastructure Fund (Infrastructuurfonds), fixing expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros by budget article. The attached memorandum extract covers project budgets, Coast Guard (Kustwacht) costs, and maintenance and renovation of the national road and waterway network.
q: Article 1 The budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2015 belonging to this act is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34475-VIII.s: This is a revised 2015 budget act (slotwet) for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and its agencies DUO and the National Archives, adjusting appropriations and realized figures per article. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, and the explanatory memorandum only reports budget deviations.

34550-XVI.s: This bill formally establishes the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, setting expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros by article. It also fixes the 2017 budget statements for the three operating agencies with a baten-lastenstelsel (CBG, CIBG and RIVM), and provides that the law enters into force on 1 January 2017.
q: By establishing this article, the income and expenditure, the balance of income and expenditure, and the capital expenditure and receipts of the operating agencies included in the statement are fixed for the year in question.

Met de vaststelling van dit wetsartikel worden de baten en de lasten, het saldo van de baten en de lasten en de kapitaaluitgaven en -ontvangsten van de in de staat opgenomen baten-lastenagentschappen voor het onderhavige jaar vastgesteld.

34725-XIII.s: This bill is a supplementary budget law (Slotwet) amending the 2016 budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the agencies under it, and the Animal Health Fund, adjusting appropriations and realisations in thousands of euros. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to oversight or legal protection.
q: We ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2016 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd

34730-XVI.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2017 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adjusting appropriations for curative care, long-term care, training and other items in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date of the amendment as 1 June 2017, with retroactive effect where the gazette appears later.
34730-XVI.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to lower training intake, nominal cost developments and new care policy, without any delegation of power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

34775-XV.s: The bill establishes the 2018 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, fixing expenditure, commitments and receipts in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force rules, with the act taking effect on 1 January of the budget year or the day after publication if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2018 attached to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

34950-XIII.s: This bill (Slotwet 2017) amends the 2017 budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII), its agencies, and the Animal Health Fund to reflect final realised figures. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: So it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have found good and resolved, as We hereby find good and resolve
Zo is het, dat Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

35450-XIV.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2020 budgets of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the NVWA food safety agency and the Animal Health Fund, adding funds for livestock emission pilots, slaughterhouse supervision and the phosphate rights system. It makes no delegation of rule-making power and no change to oversight or judicial review.
q: This change concerns additional funds for the NVWA to improve the uniformity of supervision and to strengthen permanent supervision in slaughterhouses.
Deze mutatie betreft extra middelen voor de NVWA voor het verbeteren van de uniformiteit van het toezicht en voor het versterken van het permanente toezicht in de slachthuizen.

35450-XVI.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and its agencies, adjusting expenditure and income figures in thousands of euros with effect from the day after publication and retroactive to 1 May 2020. The explanatory memorandum describes supplementary spending, including COVID-19 measures, guarantees, and extra funding for agencies and subsidies.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have approved and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2020 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd

35850-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate and the budget of its executive agencies, through a first supplementary budget (eerste suppletoire begroting). It increases expenditure and revenue lines and sets the effective date as the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2021.
q: We have found and resolved to amend the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII), as shown in the attached statement.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd

36350-XIV.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statutes of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and of the Animal Health Fund, through a first supplementary budget. It raises spending and commitments mainly for agencies such as the NVWA and RVO, and rebalances funds across policy articles.
36350-XIV.j: The memorandum justifies the increases by structural costs of statutory tasks (European information exchange, generic supervision, Woo requests, objection and appeal handling) that cannot be charged to industry.
q: These mainly concern the structural costs of carrying out statutory tasks that, under national regulation and policy, cannot be charged to industry.
Het betreft hier met name de structurele kosten voor de uitvoering van wettelijke taken die op grond van nationale regelgeving en beleid niet in rekening kunnen worden gebracht bij het bedrijfsleven.

36350-XVI.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adding about 12.7 billion euro in commitments and 12.2 billion in expenditure, and amends the 2023 budget of its agency RIVM. The accompanying memorandum explains the budget changes across health care, the financial picture for health care spending, and the supplementary budget's effect on the expenditure ceiling.
36350-XVI.j: The memorandum justifies the budget amendments by pointing to the need for changes to the departmental budget and to funding for specific health policy measures.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2023

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2023

36435-XIII.s: This supplementary budget bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, adjusting commitments and expenditure across policy articles on economy, business innovation, energy and Groningen. It takes retroactive effect to 19 September 2023 and contains no new delegations of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36725-VIII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the 2025 budget of agency DUO, with effect from 23 April 2025. The bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power; its articles only set the amended budget figures in thousands of euros and its entry-into-force date.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science for 2025 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36800-XIV.s: This bill is the 2026 budget act for the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature, setting departmental expenditure and receipts, the NVWA agency budget and the Diergezondheidsfonds budget. It fixes amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 January of the budget year, without itself delegating rule-making power.
36800-XIV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget mainly through policy measures on nitrogen, manure, innovation and supervision funding, not through any delegation of powers.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2026 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering had no remarks on the 2026 budget bill for the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature (XIV) and the Animal Health Fund (F), and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport, dated 15 September 2025, states that some budgets required amendments and refers to attachments for these changes.

36800-XVI.s: This bill fixes the 2026 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the budget statements for its agencies, in thousands of euros, with entry into force on 1 January 2026. The accompanying explanatory memorandum describes spending priorities and multi-year budget projections but does not itself create new delegations or powers.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2026 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division had no remarks on the 2026 budget bill (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and advised submitting it to the House. The minister's reply (nader rapport) reports technical amendments to the budget, such as flexibility in article 3 and updated CPB figures in article 8, but no substantive legal objections were raised.

36915-XX.s: This first supplementary budget for 2026 amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of Asylum and Migration and the budget of its agency IND, with net expenditure changes of about minus 499 million euros for the ministry and plus 632 thousand euros for IND. The explanatory memorandum mainly describes reallocations within the asylum and migration budget, including new municipal funding for public safety measures and reduced spending on Ukrainian displaced persons.
36915-XX.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the coalition agreement and fiscal measures, and gives no justification for any delegation or new powers.
q: Municipalities can themselves decide which measures best suit their local situation.
Gemeenten kunnen zelf bepalen welke maatregelen het beste bij hun lokale situatie passen.
